goal_intent: work out whether to eat here this weekend, then book if it suits

turns.utterance: Hi there, I'm thinking of organising a little get-together with some friends this weekend and wanted to check if your place is good for groups. Is it a bustling sort of spot, or more relaxed?
Glad to hear it! There’ll be five of us, and we’re all looking forward to catching up over some good food. Is this a busy time of year for you, or do you expect it’ll be fairly quiet?
We were hoping for this coming Sunday—it seems like the perfect day for a meal, especially with the weather being so nice lately. Will you be open then?
We were thinking about 6:30pm—it’s a good time for everyone to settle in and enjoy the evening together. Does that work for your schedule?
That’s great, thanks! No allergies or special requirements this time—everyone’s pretty easygoing about food. The booking will be under Marcus Bell, if you need anything else just let me know.
Perfect, thanks so much for booking us in! We’re all looking forward to it. Have a lovely day and see you Sunday. [END OF CALL]
